question.en: Discuss the role of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) in fostering global digital inclusion and its significance for a developing economy like India.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) in fostering global digital inclusion and its significance for a developing economy like India.

modelAnswer.en: The ITU plays a critical role in setting global standards for ICT, which allows developing nations to adopt cost-effective technologies. For India, ITU membership is vital for securing satellite orbital slots, participating in 5G/6G standard-setting, and accessing technical assistance to bridge the rural-urban digital divide.
